production_candle_mint: forex_bot.oanda_client.fetch_ohlcv calls bind_live_frame only after a successful InstrumentsCandles response
production_quote_mint: forex_bot.oanda_client.fetch_pricing_snapshot calls bind_live_quote only after a successful pricing response
research_synthetic: runner.synthetic_market calls bind_synthetic_frame and cannot become OANDA_LIVE_VERIFIED by a label
unsealed_constructor: Provenance(OANDA_LIVE_VERIFIED) without the private seal raises spoofed_live_classification
same_process_limitation: Any code already running in the process can call the mint helpers. Python module visibility is not a security boundary. The digest binds the frame to that local acquisition event. It does not cryptographically prove the broker sent the bytes.
stronger_isolation: A separate acquisition process would be a future architecture change. It is not implemented in G.7.
